experiment_name: Meno-J Experiment 9: WESAD Real-Data Falsification Study
research_questions: Does conformal score and conditioning choice materially alter subject-level WESAD coverage?
Does motion-region conditioning improve worst-subject coverage without relying on uninformative full prediction sets?
Does the safest synthetic Experiment 6 pair transfer to real WESAD windows?

window_contract.eligibility: Window lies fully inside one contiguous included-label run.
window_contract.features: Nine deterministic distribution/dynamics statistics for five scalar chest channels plus three acceleration axes and acceleration magnitude.

evaluation_contract.motion_region: Low/high motion assigned using the calibration-only median of ACC magnitude standard deviation.

primary_comparison.transfer_support: Safest pair improves worst-subject mean coverage by at least 0.05 and does not increase mean full-set frequency by more than 0.20.
primary_comparison.transfer_falsification: The coverage improvement is below 0.05 or full-set frequency increases by more than 0.20.
